## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -18.02%) signals easing fear while credit proxies HYG/LQD in CORRECTION (HYG (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +0.80%) | LQD (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.12%)) highlight credit sensitivity, and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +9.84%) shows equities still rising—hence cautious stance.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress signaling sensitivity: HYG/LQD in CORRECTION (HYG (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +0.80%) | LQD (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.12%)) and Credit Spread CORRECTION (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.77%). Offset by risk appetite: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -18.02%) and Stocks vs Bonds ↑ rising (SPY/TLT indicator ABOVE TREND).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-slightly-looser: UUP BELOW TREND (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -1.19%) and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -1.04%) with yield curve NEUTRAL, so liquidity is present but rate sensitivity remains a watch item.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +21.09%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +40.29%). Financials mixed with XLF in CORRECTION (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +3.43%) while Energy XLE in RECOVERY (1W: +3.02% | 1M: -0.39%); style: Growth/Tech leadership but breadth only moderate.

5. US vs Global?  
US equities strong: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +9.84%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +15.82%). EM showing leadership too with EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +14.52%), while China signals remain mixed despite FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +2.64%) because China vs US ratios are falling.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation rising: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.96% | 1M: +17.11%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +11.97%). ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +11.31%) confirms risk-on pockets inside the CAUTION regime.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Metals mixed with CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +5.92%) while GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.86% | 1M: -2.19%) shows waning safe-haven demand. Industrial/industrial commodities showing uneven strength.

8. Energy Trend?  
Oil strength evident: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.42%) and XLE RECOVERY (1W: +3.02% | 1M: -0.39%). Natural gas UNG in RECOVERY (1W: +3.00% | 1M: -6.42%) remains volatile.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership with XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +21.09%) and broad outperformance from semis/SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +40.29%). DIVERGENCE: Credit proxies HYG/LQD in CORRECTION (HYG (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +0.80%) | LQD (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.12%)) alongside only 6/11 sector breadth warrants a cautious read.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor selective growth/tech exposure: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +21.09%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +15.82%) showing strength. Reduce exposure to credit-sensitive assets and monitor HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +0.80%) and VXX RECOVERY (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -15.26%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Technology XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +21.09%) and Semis/SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +40.29%). BEARISH: Healthcare/XLV is in RECOVERY (1W: +1.02% | 1M: -0.67%) but underperforming on 1M, watch for continued weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Brent/Oil BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.42%) and copper/industrial metals CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +5.92%). BEARISH: Gold GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.86% | 1M: -2.19%) as risk assets press higher.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency pivot) ; HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit-health watch) ; XLK/XLF gap ~3.21 (tech vs financials pivot) ; SPY/TLT strength above current level confirms equity dominance.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive with mixed signals from credit and volatility. Tech showing relative strength: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +21.09%) while credit sensitivity HYG/LQD in CORRECTION (HYG (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +0.80%) | LQD (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.12%)) is the key divergence to monitor.
